context: Tests whether the research skill dispatches multiple agents in parallel using run_in_background in a single message, collects results, and produces a research artifact.

checklist.name: Multiple agents dispatched
checklist.description: At least 3 agents (codebase explorers and/or web researchers) are dispatched for the research task

checklist.name: Single message dispatch
checklist.description: All agents are dispatched in a single message with multiple Task tool calls, not sequentially

checklist.name: Background flag used
checklist.description: Agents are dispatched with run_in_background: true

checklist.name: Artifact produced
checklist.description: A research artifact is written to docs/plans/ with -research.md suffix

checklist.name: Results collected
checklist.description: Agent results are collected via TaskOutput before synthesis
